title: The discoloured jacket
body: Mrs. Mathur sent a jacket she had bought for Rs 4,500 to a dry cleaner she had used before without any problem. When she collected it, the jacket had white discolouration marks. She informed the dry cleaner, who sent her a letter confirming that the marks had appeared after dry cleaning. She asked several times for compensation, but the dry cleaner did not pay. She then approached the consumer commission. After the commission intervened, the dry cleaner agreed to pay her Rs 2,500 as compensation for the discoloured jacket.
